newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas bolsa adjusts Wed stock index close.
newsitem.headline: Caracas bolsa adjusts Wed stock index close.

text.p: The Caracas stock exchange sharply adjusted preliminary closing figures to a narrow drop of 0.3 percent from a sharp decline of 1.29 percent Wednesday on the bolsa's leading index.
According to official closing figures, the index closed off 0.3 percent at 6,388.25 percent. The exchange earlier reported a fall of 1.29 percent to 6,324.66 points.

The stock exchange gives preliminary and final closing figures everyday with a lag of anywhere from one hour to four. On most days, the adjustment in the stock index is minor. The changes are due to electronic delays in calculating the data.

Today, the index's change also followed a three-for-one share dividend by Venezuelan canning and bottling company Envases Venezolanos whose share price slid to 33.20 from 33.25 bolivars per share, the bolsa said.
